properties.label: Target Form
properties.description:
Select the Joget form that stores synced Microsoft Calendar events.

Important:
• The selected form must contain event start date/time fields.
• Reminder flags will be updated in this form.
• This tool does NOT sync from Microsoft Graph.

properties.label: Event Timing Fields
properties.description:
Fields used to determine when reminders should be triggered.

Rules:
• Uses local user time stored in the form.
• No UTC conversion is performed here.
• Reminder is calculated as Event Start - Reminder Minutes.

properties.label: Reminder Configuration
properties.description:
Fields controlling reminder behavior.

Reminder Minutes:
• Numeric value representing minutes before event start.
• Example: 15 means reminder is sent 15 minutes before the event.

Reminder Sent Flag:
• Used to prevent duplicate reminders.
• Automatically updated by the tool.

properties.name: reminderWindowMinutes
properties.label: Reminder Window Minutes
properties.description: Allowed window around reminder time to avoid missing events when scheduler delayed.

properties.label: Technical Notes
properties.description:
This tool is designed to run as a Scheduler Plugin or Process Tool.

Execution Behavior:
• Does NOT call Microsoft Graph.
• Reads event data from the database only.
• Safe to run every 1–5 minutes.
• Sends reminder only once per event.

Recommended Schedule:
• Every 1 minute for near-real-time reminders.
• Every 5 minutes for reduced load.
